description:
Validate vault files against the schemas directory.

Usage: [PATH ...] — with no paths, walks the whole vault and validates everything.

Args:
  PATHS — zero or more files to validate.

Flags:
  --schemas DIR — schemas directory; defaults to the schemas directory shipped alongside the tools.
  --quiet — suppress per-violation output, leaving only the exit code.

Violations print as <path>:<line>: <message>.

Examples:
  []
  ["--quiet"]
  ["notes/2026-06-01-14-30-00.md"]

Notes:
  Exit 0 means clean, exit 1 means violations were found, exit 2 is a tool-level failure.
  Read-only; it never rewrites files.
  Run after `buffer flush` and after `tasks` ingest to confirm the vault still validates.
